hero.title: Your IT shouldn’t slow you down.
hero.subtitle: We handle infrastructure, security and support — so you can focus on what matters: your business. Modern technology, forward-thinking care, no surprises on your invoice. Based in Munich, supporting businesses worldwide.

services.title: IT that just works. Backed by people who care.
services.intro: From laptops to servers, from Wi-Fi to AI: we take care of everything your business needs in IT. Mac or Windows, iPhone or Android, one office or many.

devices.title: Devices & workstations
devices.text: Setup, updates and fast help for Mac, Windows, iPhone, Android and printers. New team members are ready to go from day one.

network.title: Network & servers
network.text: Reliable Wi-Fi in every room, secure remote access via VPN and your own Linux servers for your files and internal services.

email.title: Email & collaboration
email.text: Email on your own domain, shared calendars and files. With Microsoft, Google or open source, independent of US providers if you prefer.

web.title: Websites & hosting
web.text: We design and build your website and take care of domain and hosting, whether at Strato, IONOS & co. or on your own server.

security.title: Security & backup
security.text: Password managers, two-factor sign-in, backups and malware protection, so a mistake or an attack doesn’t turn into a crisis.

ai.title: AI at work
ai.text: We show your team where AI really saves time, set up ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot with privacy in mind, and automate tedious routine tasks.

process.title: One point of contact for all your IT
process.intro: New laptop, Wi-Fi trouble or an AI project: you always talk to the same people. We give honest advice, source the right hardware and software if you like, and are there fast when something breaks.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.title: Get to know each other
steps.text: A free conversation: what do you use, what bugs you, what should get better? Afterwards you know where you stand, with no obligation.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.title: Inventory & setup
steps.text: We document devices, accounts and licences, bring everything up to a secure standard and set up what’s missing.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.title: Support & care
steps.text: We stay your point of contact: quick help when something goes wrong, honest advice before every purchase and documentation that’s always up to date.

cta.message: Good IT is invisible. You don’t think about it — it just works. That’s what we deliver.

contact.title: Let’s talk.
contact.subtitle: Tell us briefly what you need. We’ll get back to you as soon as possible.
